newsitem.title: USA: U.S. EPA adds five sites to Superfund list.
newsitem.headline: U.S. EPA adds five sites to Superfund list.

text.p: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency on Friday said it added five sites to its Superfund National Priorities List.

The EPA also proposed that six other sites be added to the list that informs the public of uncontrolled hazardous waste sites that need further investigation to determine whether they pose risks to human health and the environment.

Sites added to the list were Brunswick Wood Preserving in Brunswick, Georgia; Ross Metals Inc in Rossville, Tennessee; Palermo Well Field Ground Water Contamination in Tumwater, Washington; Tyndall Air Force Base in Panama City, Florida; and Norfolk Naval Base in Norfolk, Virginia.

Proposed to be added to the list were Florida Petroleum Reprocessors in Fort Lauderdale, Florida; Terry Creek Dredge Spoil Areas/Hercules Outfall in Brunswick, Georgia; DePue/New Jersey Zinc/Mobil Chemical Corp, in DePue, Illinois; Salford Quarry in Lower Salford Township, Pennsylvania; Sprague Road Ground Water Plume in Odessa, Texas; and Fort George G. Meade in Odenton, Maryland.
